name: Diana Schneider
headline: R&D | Digital Strategy | Innovation Design | Project Management
summary:
Innovation management and R&D strategy across sectors: venture prototyping, business design, user-centric product/ service design and (digital) roadmapping for robotics, retail, healthcare, banking, biotech, mobility, energy, CO2 removal.

Cross-functional team leadership, c-level stakeholder management and project delivery from first innovation workshop or trend/ user/ technology research to multi-year interim business unit management.

Clients include BNPParibas, CureVac, Carmeuse, Magazino (Jungheinrich), Carrefour, Colruyt Group, Volkswagen, Deutsche Bank, Maxeda (Brico), Fraunhofer, Trumpf and more.

positions.title: Strategic Design Consultant
positions.description: consultant for the CIO and Global Director of Digital, including process mapping, legal risk management, CO2 reduction strategies, fit gap analysis for IT vendor selection, change management, customer journey mapping, IT conference on AI/ Smart Factory, new venture ideation, etc.

positions.title: Innovation Consulting
positions.description: freelance design strategist bringing Industrial Design methods to the business reality of organisations through co-creation between innovators (product design, service strategists, user research, technology scouting) and clients. Led digital transformation projects for governmental and corporate clients including risk management, R&D strategy, product dev, UX

positions.title: Strategic Design Lead
positions.description: vision & launch of the Service Design unit at Colruyt Group, driving C-level strategic initiatives including ecosystem vision workshops, design sprints, recruiting and leadership of in-house Product and Service Designers, introduction of new tools and processes of quantitative & qualitative user research and collaborated closely with Product Owners/ UX Designers/ Developers/ IT Architects

positions.title: Strategic Design Consultant
positions.description: strategic design consultant in multidisciplinary corporate investment & incubation projects by BCG, participated in intrapreneurship sprints and digital product development tracks, roles included market research, requirement definition, risk assessment, competitive mapping and stakeholder presentations
